'''Skeletal clone troopers''' were specialized [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. The overall armor resembled the [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]]. As indicated by the name, their armor was primarily colored black, with white patterns placed throughout the body that resembled a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Skeleton/Legends|skeleton]]. They also carried [[scythe-staff]]s into battle.

==Behind the scenes==
The skeletal clone trooper was a purchasable outfit in the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]. Their use of scythes was a reference to the [[Wikipedia:Grim Reaper|Grim Reaper]], the personification of [[Death/Legends|Death]].
